instructions: Preheat the oven and prepare all ingredients for american egg baked potatoes.
Season the eggs and vegetables evenly while the oven reaches temperature.
Arrange the eggs, potatoes, and vegetables so heat can circulate around each component.
Bake until the eggs is safely cooked and the vegetables or grain base are tender.
Rest the american egg baked potatoes briefly, adjust the seasoning, and divide it into four portions.
